description: End-to-end test script for managing booking questions in a web application using Playwright. It includes tests for adding, editing, hiding questions, and verifying form behavior and webhook calls.

methods.name: getLabelLocator
methods.description: Returns the locator for the label element associated with a given form field.

methods.name: getLabelText
methods.description: Retrieves the inner text of the label associated with a form field.

methods.name: expectSystemFieldsToBeThereOnBookingPage
methods.description: Verifies presence and values of system fields (name, email, notes, guests) on the booking page.

methods.name: bookTimeSlot
methods.description: Fills in booking form fields and optionally submits the form to book a time slot.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects an option from a dropdown menu based on visible text.

methods.name: addQuestionAndSave
methods.description: Adds a new question to the form builder and saves it.

methods.name: expectErrorToBeThereFor
methods.description: Checks for the presence of an error message for a specific form field.

methods.name: doOnFreshPreview
methods.description: Opens a new preview tab, runs a callback, and optionally keeps the tab open.

methods.name: doOnFreshPreviewWithSearchParams
methods.description: Opens a preview tab with specific URL search parameters, runs a callback, and optionally keeps the tab open.

methods.name: toggleQuestionAndSave
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a question and saves the form.

methods.name: toggleQuestionRequireStatusAndSave
methods.description: Toggles the 'required' status of a question and saves the form.

methods.name: createAndLoginUserWithEventTypes
methods.description: Creates a user with event types and logs in via API.

methods.name: rescheduleFromTheLinkOnPage
methods.description: Performs rescheduling by clicking a link and selecting a new time.

methods.name: openBookingFormInPreviewTab
methods.description: Opens the booking form in a new preview tab and waits for it to load.

methods.name: saveEventType
methods.description: Saves the current event type configuration via API call.

methods.name: addWebhook
methods.description: Creates a webhook receiver and registers a webhook with specific event triggers.

methods.name: expectWebhookToBeCalled
methods.description: Verifies that a webhook request was received with expected payload.
